name: Commerce License Entity Field
description: Provides a single Commerce License type (`entity_field`) that, while a license is active, writes an admin-configured value onto a configured field of a buyer-selected target entity (via a dynamic_entity_reference). Grant sets the field and saves the entity; revoke resets the field to its default and saves. A form_alter hook hides the delete action on any entity whose field is controlled by an active license. The module is declared incomplete: the buyer-facing cart-form entity-selection widget is unfinished. No routes, permissions, services, or config schema of its own.
php_requirement: >=8.1 (inherited from Drupal core; ^10.1 needs PHP 8.1+, ^11 needs PHP 8.3+; the module declares no PHP constraint of its own and ships no composer.json)
project_description:
The Commerce License Entity Field module provides a License type for Commerce License which when granted, sets a value on an entity field. The field and the value are configured in the product, while the entity to change is chosen by the purchasing user.

 Back to top 

 Example use cases 
 Site users create article nodes. A user can upgrade one of their article nodes to be promoted to the front page by purchasing an entity field license.

 A single Product Variation holds the configuration of the entity type and bundle, the name of the field to set, and the value to set.

 When a user purchases a license, they set the article entity to which the license applies.

 Back to top 

 Status 
 This module is incomplete. See the README for details.
